name: Amelie Agile North
source: Actress and fitness model. Since she was young, she has dedicated a large part of her life to exercising and cultivating her body. This has made her very vain, she loves to show off her figure whenever she can, even when the time is not right. She also likes to hoard money, due to a childhood where luxuries were in short supply. She is currently in a romantic relationship with Haru Valentine.
